summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload via bundled Bun binary
details: package.json declares preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style _0xNNNNNN identifiers, per-function string-dispatch tables) despite implementing only download-and-execute logic: it fetches the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmod+x's the binary, and immediately invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) heavily obfuscated with string-array rotation (WV8StW shift function and a multi-KB encoded literal array `n7gIxM`). The declared package purpose is a React direct-mail components library, which has no legitimate need to drop a second language runtime at install time or to execute an opaque 727KB payload under it. Installing this version causes attacker-authored code — hidden from Node-based static review by being compiled for and executed under Bun — to run automatically on the installer's host during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
